integrity: Analytic proof and finite diagnostic checker included; spectral open/closed examples use an explicit infinite direct sum. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to antiunitary maps, not arbitrary bounded antilinear operators; a generic symmetric-antilinear form theorem may imply portions. Finite checks do not prove spectral projection claims.
title: Exact open and closed q-numerical disks of infinite-dimensional antiunitaries
